method: Walk-forward Sequential COSTAR-TS Q/K attention comparison
test_usage: NO TEST DATA LOADED OR EVALUATED

architecture.embedding: Original SequentialCOSTARTSRouterFull: sequential state followed by linear utility head.
architecture.qk: Original sequential state s_t, Q=W_Q(s_t), K_j=W_K(e_j), score_j=Q dot K_j / sqrt(d_attn). No V/context.
architecture.qkv: Q/K scores over learned expert embeddings form attention probabilities, V_j=W_V(e_j), context=sum a_j V_j, fused state=LayerNorm(s_t+projection(context)), final scores from fused Q against K.
